description: This Java class defines a Fragment named LogFragment used in an Android application. It creates and manages a custom LogView within a ScrollView to display log data, sets up visual styles and layout parameters, and handles text change events to auto-scroll the view when new log messages are added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a log using a custom LogView inside a ScrollView, managing its layout, styling, and automatic scrolling behavior.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, attaches a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new log entries, and returns the main view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the instance of LogView managed by this fragment.
